draft.title: Fractions, decimals and percentages
card: A fraction, a decimal and a percentage can show the same amount. For example, 1/4 = 0.25 = 25%.
divide the top number by the bottom number. 3/5 = 3 ÷ 5 = 0.6.
multiply by 100. 0.6 × 100 = 60%. To go back, divide by 100.
write the percentage over 100, then simplify. 60% = 60/100 = 3/5.
draft.remember: Percent means out of 100. Divide by 100 to go from a percentage to a decimal, and multiply by 100 to go back.

a.why: Divide the top by the bottom: 3 ÷ 8 = 0.375. Dividing 8 by 3 instead gives 2.67, which is the mistake of turning the fraction upside down.
a.clue: Divide the top number by the bottom number.

b.q: Mia scored 0.7 on one quiz, 65% on another and 3/4 on a third. Which list puts these in order from smallest to largest?
b.why: Write each as a percentage: 0.7 = 70%, 65% stays 65%, and 3/4 = 75%. The order is 65%, 70%, 75%. Comparing 0.7 with 65 without converting wrongly makes 0.7 look smaller.
b.clue: Write all three amounts in the same form first.

check.summary: No problems found. The conversions on the card are correct, both questions have exactly one right answer, and the explanations match the card.
